# ZeroOne.com

> ZeroOne.com is an elite-level .com domain. It is owned by Coherence.com and may be in development.

## Key facts

- Domain: zeroone.com (two English words, "zero" and "one", seven letters, .com; no numerals, no hyphen)
- Owner: Coherence.com — https://coherence.com
- Status: may be in development
- Contact: team@coherence.com (subject: "Domain name: zeroone.com")
- Price or sale terms: not published

## Meaning

Zero and one are the only two digits in binary, the number system computers use to store and process information. "Zero to one" is also shorthand for creating something that did not exist before.

## Suitable industries

Artificial intelligence, software and SaaS, computing hardware, cybersecurity, fintech and payments, venture capital and start-ups, data and analytics, education and coding, robotics and IoT, gaming and esports, design and product studios, and energy and smart grids.
